crucialFeats: Kills countless gods with his Necrosword.

dossier.advantage: All-Black – the sword that negates immortality. The weapon ignores every form of armor and regeneration, and Knull himself returns to the fight even after total incineration.
dossier.mentality: Sadistic confidence and lack of fear. He revels in his power, striving for the swift and ruthless execution of every opponent.
dossier.quote: Ah... I see my reputation precedes me... so I won't waste your time... I am going to kill your world.
dossier.style: Aggressive necro-swordsmanship. Knull strikes with devastating force, aiming for swift dismemberment or decapitation of the opponent.

fighterA.name: Knull

powers: All-Black necrosword lethality, living abyss manipulation, symbiote hive control, and high-end regeneration.
tools: Battlefield corruption, symbiote conversion pressure, and persistent close-range threat.
Ability to manifest shadow armies, forcing the opponent to constantly expend energy on area-of-effect attacks.
weaknesses: Strong anti-abyss or high-intensity light counters can disrupt his core advantages.
Broad cosmic energy control can force him to spend more effort on recovery and tempo reset.

crucialFeats: Absorbs the life-force of all Asgardians.
Breaches impenetrable Dome made by Celestials.
Gathers power from all of the Earth gods.
Absorbs Surtur, whose destiny is to destroy Asgard and kill gods.

dossier.advantage: Odinforce and the destructive power of the Odinsword. This weapon releases Ragnarok energy capable of erasing galaxies, and the Odinforce allows him to manipulate matter and time.
dossier.mentality: Majestic ruler with a violent temperament. Drawing the Odinsword means fighting without any inhibitions – he strikes with a fury that knows no mercy or compromise.
dossier.quote: Odin is the Sun and the stars and the Moon and more. Odin is the way and the wrath and the wonder! Odin is he who speaks while galaxies obey!
dossier.style: Direct combat with the colossal Odinsword. Odin uses devastating slashes to physically break the opponent's armor and will with pure striking power.

fighterB.name: Odin

powers: Full Odinforce, large-scale energy projection, barriers, transmutation, and divine sorcery.
tools: Destroyer Armor and Odinsword for top-tier cosmic warfare.
Reality manipulation at a galactic scale, allowing him to reset unfavorable battlefield conditions.
weaknesses: Output and precision can vary with context, burden, and prolonged conflict.
Strategic overconfidence can create openings against persistent opponents.

battle-dynamics.label: Odinforce: Cleansing
battle-dynamics.phase_1: Odin imposes cosmic order from the very start. Odinforce acts as a perfect counter to the structures of the Abyss.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Knull tries to flood the battlefield with shadows, but Odin's divine light burns away every regeneration attempt.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Odinforce Cleansing closes the fight. Knull is cut off from the source of his power.
battle-dynamics.analysis: In this scenario, Odinforce is a hard counter to the Abyss. Knull loses his regeneration advantage.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: The opening is a brutal exchange. Odin relies on raw force, while Knull uses the lethal slashes of All-Black.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: Without specific cleansing, the fight turns into a marathon. Odin inflicts wounds that Knull simply ignores.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: Knull starts to take over through the economy of All-Black. Every minute favors the King in Black.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: Without a specific counter, Odin must be perfect for far too long.

fight-simulation.label: Odinforce: Cleansing
fight-simulation.opening: Odin opens with a salvo of pure energy that scatters Knull's first strands of the Abyss.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Knull tries to answer with All-Black, but Destroyer armor and Odin's barriers make every contact costly.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Odin senses Knull's weakening bond with the Abyss and strikes with full Cleansing power, ending the duel.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Victory through total battlefield cleansing and erasure of Knull's essence.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Odinforce hits the shadow structure, shattering Knull's first attempts at dominance.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: Odinsword collides with All-Black in the epicenter of nothingness, where light fights to survive.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Odin pushes back the darkness and takes control of the space.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Knull wraps shadows around the divine blade, trying to extinguish it.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Odin releases the ultimate Cleansing wave, burning Knull's essence from the fabric of the universe.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Knull is erased from the current plane of existence.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: The shadows are pacified, leaving Knull defenseless.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: Knull floods the battlefield with living Abyss, forcing Odin to fight under unfavorable conditions.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: Odin deals wounds that Knull immediately resets, pulling the god into a loop with no exit.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_a: Odin tries to break the loop with pure, brutal force.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_b: Knull revels in the helplessness of divine attacks.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Knull's blade slowly corners Odin, cutting off escape routes and dimming his radiance.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_a: Odin regains distance at the last moment.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: Blackness starts to pour through the Odinforce barriers.
fight-simulation.s2_end_condition: The slow fading of divine light under the pressure of endless darkness.

final-summary.line_1: In this clash, there is no room for compromise or tournament rules - this is a fight for ultimate existence.
final-summary.line_2: Odinforce Cleansing is the only factor that lets Odin permanently break Knull's regeneration loop.
final-summary.line_3: Without this specific counter, Knull simply outlasts every attack and wins through attrition.

tactical-board.lane: Odin must turn chaos into order before Knull turns order into attrition.
tactical-board.subtitle: God Butcher vs All-Father

verdict-matrix.case_1: Odin 7.5/10. With Cleansing active, Odin has the right tool to neutralize the Abyss. His battlefield control becomes impossible for Knull to break, leading to total erasure of symbiote essence.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Knull 8/10. Without a specific counter to regeneration, Odin becomes just another exceptionally powerful god to cut down. All-Black and the Abyss regeneration loop inevitably win the resource war.
verdict-matrix.subtitle: Verdict depends on the use of Cleansing

x-factor.factor: COUNTER TO THE ABYSS VS DIVINE DAMAGE
x-factor.implikacja: Victory depends on whether Odin treats Knull as matter or as a metaphysical infection.
x-factor.mechanika: Knull wins if Odinforce is only physical energy. Odin wins if it works like an antivirus against the Abyss.
x-factor.psychologia: Both fight for everything. Knull wants repeatable darkness, while Odin wants one final cleansing.
